title: Boolean Algebra & Logic Simplification
description: Axioms, De Morgan's laws, duality theorem, Karnaugh maps, and Quine-McCluskey minimization.

title: Logic Gates & Universal Realizations
description: AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR gates; universal NAND/NOR logic realization.

title: Combinational Logic Circuits
description: Adders, subtractors, multiplexers, demultiplexers, encoders, and decoders.

title: Sequential Circuits & Flip-Flops
description: SR latches, D flip-flops, JK flip-flops, T flip-flops, master-slave operation, and counters.
